splintertree_guard: Splintertree Post. Warsong ground - the Horde's only wall in eastern Ashenvale. The gate is on the south side and the command tent is at the north end. Move along unless you have business here, and if you have, take it to the Overseer.
splintertree_flight_master: Windrider roost, north side of Splintertree. I fly to the Crossroads and on to Orgrimmar, and to anywhere else you have already walked to. The forest is quicker from above and nothing up there bites. Where to?
splintertree_commander: Overseer Gorada. I command Splintertree from this tent. Orgrimmar wants timber out of Ashenvale, the elves want us out of it, and the demons want everyone out of it. The demons do not sleep, so neither do we. What do you need?
splintertree_interrogator: Vashj, interrogator. My tent is beside the Overseer's, so she can hear the answers. Every satyr we drag in from the Throne, north of here, swears the void is close to breaking through. I would like to know how close, and I have run out of satyrs to ask.
splintertree_barracks_sergeant: Krull, barracks sergeant. The barracks are the west side of the post. Every warrior we send north to the Throne comes back changed, if they come back at all. I count them out and I count them in, and I have never once had the same number.
pt_splintertree_hide: Skarn, tanner. East side of the post. Hide, leather, cloth, and the meat off the same carcass - pay once and I teach the lot, cooking included. The bears here are worth the skinning. The wolves out of the Wastes are not. Do not bring me those.
splintertree_war_mage: War Mage Grimtotem. Gorada holds the command tent. I hold what is past the wall: the Throne to the north, the Barrow to the north-east, the Wastes to the east. Three fires and one bucket. Neither of us sleeps much.
splintertree_grunt: Bloodfang, grunt. I stand the west half of the post. The Demon Wastes, east of here, used to be scorched dirt and nothing else. Now things crawl out of it at night, and some of them come in and steal my tent pegs.
splintertree_scout: Veyra. Scout. I keep to the west fence, as far from the fires as I can get, so my eyes stay good. I have seen things past that treeline I cannot unsee. Most of them were carrying orders.
pt_splintertree_essence: Mogor. Tinker Mogor - the smith with my name is the other one, down by the south-east fence. I teach engineering on the east side. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and a steady hand. Bring me the first two.
pt_splintertree_wood: Karga, woodwright. I teach in the middle of the post. Fell it, saw it, make something of it - and in Ashenvale, do the felling where the elves cannot see you. The sawmill is in the south-west corner, beside the forge.
splintertree_innkeeper: Rukka. This is the inn, east side of Splintertree - a tent with a floor, but the stew is hot. Even a war camp needs a meal. Bind your hearth here and you will fight easier for knowing where your bed is.
ct_splintertree: Bruga. I train every discipline for the Warsong, here beside the inn. The Overseer sends me loggers and wants soldiers back by morning. Show me where you are, and bring coin.
pt_splintertree_forge: Mogor. Mining and smithing, both halves or neither. I teach by the south-east fence. The post's forge is clear across the yard in the south-west corner, by the sawmill - learn here, hammer there, and mind the logging carts between.
splintertree_watch_sentry: Mokka. I be de eyes on de south wall, by de gate. Quiet tonight. Too quiet, if ya ask me. Every night dere is smoke out in de Demon Wastes, east of here, and every night it be a little closer to dis wall.
pt_splintertree_herbs: Garrek, apothecary. South-east corner of the post. Every weed is a medicine to someone. Ashenvale has more of them than Durotar has rocks. I will show you which to pull and what to do with it after, and the second part is where people go wrong.
